title: FlowCred: Hierarchical Credit Assignment and Functional Coordination for Joint Text-to-Video Post-Training
title_zh: FlowCred：联合文本到视频后训练中的分层信用分配与功能协调

paragraphs.en: Prompt optimization and generator post-training are two complementary ways to improve text-to-video (T2V) generation, and recent systems increasingly train both modules jointly. However, optimizing a prompt policy and a video generator from the same terminal reward creates two ambiguities: prompt quality is confounded with stochastic generation, and the two modules may realize overlapping local improvements. We introduce FlowCred , a two-level framework for joint T2V post-training. First, hierarchical credit assignment uses matched prompt–seed rollout grids to separate prompt-level credit from prompt-conditioned generator residuals under shared randomness. Second, functional coordination probes alternative current-policy prompts at states from actual generation trajectories, providing generator-aware evidence for prompt optimization while selectively attenuating generator updates already supported by conditioning changes. Across multiple T2V benchmarks, FlowCred consistently improves matched joint-training baselines. On LTX-2.5, FlowCred improves a strictly matched joint-training control from 61.47 to 64.46 on T2V-CompBench and from 55.58 to 58.08 on StoryEval, without increasing decoded-video or reward-model-call budgets. Factorial and realized-update analyses show complementary contributions from prompt shaping and generator routing, while human evaluation and transfer across backbones and updater families provide further supporting evidence.
paragraphs.zh: 提示优化和生成器后训练是改进文本到视频（T2V）生成的两种互补方法，近期的系统越来越多地联合训练这两个模块。 然而，从相同的终端奖励出发优化提示策略和视频生成器会产生两个模糊性：提示质量会与随机生成过程相互混淆，且两个模块可能会实现重叠的局部改进。 我们提出了 FlowCred，一个用于联合 T2V 后训练的两层框架。 首先，分层信用分配利用匹配的提示–种子展开网格，在共享随机性条件下将提示层面的信用与提示条件化的生成器残差分离开来。 其次，功能协调机制会在实际生成轨迹的状态下探测当前策略的替代提示，从而为提示优化提供生成器感知的证据，同时选择性地减弱已由条件变化所支持的生成器更新。 在多个 T2V 基准测试中，FlowCred 始终优于匹配的联合训练基线模型。 在 LTX-2.5 上，FlowCred 将严格匹配的联合训练控制模型在 T2V-CompBench 上的得分从 61.47 提升至 64.46，在 StoryEval 上的得分从 55.58 提升至 58.08，且未增加解码视频或奖励模型调用的资源预算。 阶乘分析和实际更新分析表明，提示塑造和生成器路由具有互补的贡献，而人类评估以及在不同骨干网络和更新器家族之间的迁移结果提供了进一步的支持证据。

paragraphs.en: Text-to-video (T2V) systems increasingly expose two trainable adaptation channels: a language-side prompt policy and the video generator itself. Prompt-side methods improve conditioning while leaving the visual model fixed ( Hao et al., 2023 ; Cao et al., 2023 ; Ji et al., 2025 ; Cheng et al., 2025 ) ; generator post-training instead changes the diffusion/flow model using reward or preference feedback ( Black et al., 2024 ; Fan et al., 2023 ; Wallace et al., 2024 ; Liu et al., 2025a ; Xue et al., 2025 ; Xue et al., 2026 ) . Recent systems optimize both modules jointly ( Wang et al., 2026a ; Cheng et al., 2026 ; Liu et al., 2026 ; Jia et al., 2026 ) . Prompt changes can reorganize entities, relations, and event descriptions before generation, whereas generator updates address residual motion, appearance, and execution errors that conditioning alone cannot remove. When only one module is updated, a terminal reward can be treated as supervision for that module; once both are trainable, the same scalar signal must implicitly serve both attribution and coordination roles. Joint post-training is therefore attractive; once both channels are trainable, however, one terminal score leaves two distinct questions unresolved.
paragraphs.zh: 文本到视频（T2V）系统越来越多地暴露出两个可训练的适应通道：语言侧的提示策略和视频生成器本身。 提示侧的方法在保持视觉模型不变的同时改进了条件约束（Hao 等，2023；Cao 等，2023；Ji 等，2025；Cheng 等，2025）；而生成器的后训练则通过奖励或偏好反馈来改变扩散/流模型（Black 等，2024；Fan 等，2023；Wallace 等，2024；Liu 等，2025a；Xue 等，2025；Xue 等，2026）。 近期的系统对两个模块进行联合优化（Wang 等，2026a；Cheng 等，2026；Liu 等，2026；Jia 等，2026）。 提示的变化可以在生成前重新组织实体、关系和事件描述，而生成器的更新则能解决仅靠条件约束无法消除的残留运动、外观和执行错误。 当只有一个模块被更新时，终端奖励可以被视为对该模块的监督；一旦两个模块都可训练，同一个标量信号就必须隐式地同时承担归因和协调的角色。 因此，联合后训练具有吸引力；然而，一旦两个通道都可训练，单一的终端得分仍会留下两个不同的问题未解。

paragraphs.en: These two ambiguities require different remedies: variance reduction can make credit estimates cleaner without preventing functional overlap, while coordinating local updates does not by itself determine where terminal variation originated. paragraphs.en: COMA counterfactual credit holds other agents fixed while marginalizing one action ( Foerster et al., 2018 ) , while leave-one-out baselines and common random numbers are standard tools for variance reduction ( Ahmadian et al., 2024 ; Ng & Jordan, 2000 ) . PCGrad/CAGrad manipulate conflicting parameter gradients across objectives ( Yu et al., 2020 ; Liu et al., 2021 ) . FlowCred instead separates statistical credit across the stochastic prompt-policy/generator hierarchy and measures functional overlap through same-state conditioning responses in the generator’s native output space.
paragraphs.zh: COMA 的反事实信用机制在边缘化单个动作的同时保持其他智能体固定（Foerster 等人，2018），而“留一法”基线和共同随机数则是方差削减的标准工具（Ahmadian 等人，2024；Ng & Jordan，2000）。 PCGrad/CAGrad 会处理不同目标之间相互冲突的参数梯度（Yu 等人，2020；Liu 等人，2021）。 FlowCred 则相反，它会在随机提示-策略/生成器层级结构中分离统计信用，并通过生成器在其原生输出空间中针对相同状态的条件响应来衡量功能重叠。

The score r t r_{t} measures held-out response support rather than reward confidence. Low-support states continuously recover the base reward step. paragraphs.en: The factorial result is complemented by a matched one-step audit on cached states. Rather than interpreting the projection energy of an individual stochastic policy-gradient sample, we measure the neural displacement after the optimizer step. Full reduces realized generator supported overlap from 0.487 to 0.264 while retaining 0.931 × \times the hierarchical-credit update norm; on the prompt side, the native-metric alignment cosine rises from 0.29 to 0.61. Shaping-only and routing-only variants isolate the corresponding upstream and downstream changes (Appendix K ). Together with the endpoint factorial, these measurements support selective coordination rather than a generic shrinkage explanation, while remaining descriptive checks of trained behavior rather than an exact transfer of causal responsibility.

paragraphs.en: Full keeps the decoded-video and reward-model-call budget identical to hierarchical credit; its additional generator work consists of non-decoded same-state transition probes, counted explicitly in Appendix I . Frozen-module swaps attribute measurable gains to both sides: substituting the Full generator into the hierarchical-credit pair adds +0.90 T2V-CompBench and substituting the Full prompt policy adds +0.72. In a 240-request blinded evaluation, Full is preferred over hierarchical credit on 134 versus 48 requests (58 ties; 73.6% of non-ties) and over PromptRL on 142 versus 46 (52 ties; 75.5% of non-ties). An independent VisionReward evaluator, never used in training or model selection, also prefers Full to hierarchical credit on 63.3% of 300 held-out matched pairs. Detailed annotation and replication protocols are in Appendices J and L .
paragraphs.zh: Full 保持了解码视频和奖励模型调用预算与分层信用机制完全一致；其额外的生成器工作包括未解码的同状态转换探针，这些在附录 I 中有明确统计。 冻结模块的替换为双方带来了可测量的增益：将 Full 生成器代入分层信用组合中，T2V-CompBench 得分增加 +0.90；而将 Full 提示策略代入，则增加 +0.72。 在一项包含 240 个请求的盲测评估中，Full 在 134 个请求中优于分层信用机制（对比 48 个），另有 58 次平局（占非平局案例的 73.6%）；在 PromptRL 方面，Full 在 142 个请求中更优（对比 46 个），另有 52 次平局（占非平局案例的 75.5%）。 一个独立的 VisionReward 评估器从未用于训练或模型选择，它在 300 对预留的匹配样本中也有 63.3% 的情况更偏好 Full 而非分层信用机制。 详细的标注与复现协议见附录 J 和 L。

paragraphs.en: We presented FlowCred , a framework for jointly post-training a prompt optimizer and a text-to-video generator without treating a shared terminal reward as undifferentiated supervision. Hierarchical credit assignment uses matched prompt–seed rollouts to separate prompt choice from prompt-fixed stochasticity, while functional coordination uses same-state response geometry for generator-aware prompt shaping and reliability-gated routing of the generator reward branch. Controlled comparisons show that the gains cannot be explained by stronger prompts, additional decoded rollouts, or generic update shrinkage alone, and evidence from repeated runs, mechanism analyses, human evaluation, and transfer studies is consistent with the intended division of labor between prompt-side conditioning and residual generator execution. More broadly, FlowCred suggests that joint post-training should distinguish where outcome variation arises from where trainable modules can realize overlapping functional changes : sharing a reward is not sufficient by itself; credit assignment and update coordination are separate design problems in cascaded generative systems.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 FlowCred，这是一个框架，用于联合后训练提示优化器和文本到视频生成器，而无需将共享的终端奖励视为不可微分的监督信号。 分层信用分配使用匹配的提示–种子运行来分离提示选择与提示固定的随机性，而功能协调则利用相同状态下的响应几何结构，实现生成器感知的提示塑造以及对生成器奖励分支的可靠性门控路由。 受控比较表明，这些增益无法仅通过更强大的提示、额外的解码运行或通用的更新收缩来解释；重复运行、机制分析、人类评估和迁移研究提供的证据也支持了提示侧条件化与剩余生成器执行之间预期的分工。 更广泛地说，FlowCred 表明，联合后训练应当区分结果变异产生的位置与可训练模块能够实现重叠功能变化的位置：仅共享奖励本身并不足够；信用分配与更新协调是级联生成系统中两个独立的设计问题。

paragraphs.en: The training pool contains 8,000 T2V requests. We build it from 4,800 programmatically instantiated compositional templates over entities, attributes, relations, counts, and actions; 2,000 independently generated motion/interaction requests; and 1,200 manually curated multi-event requests, then stratify the mixture across object/attribute binding, spatial relation, motion binding, action binding, interaction, numeracy, and longer event descriptions. Before training, requests are deduplicated against every benchmark split by normalized exact match, 5-gram MinHash (Jaccard threshold 0.80), and sentence-embedding cosine (threshold 0.92); no retained training request crosses any of these thresholds. Validation prompts are disjoint at the request level and are never used for benchmark reporting. Prompt candidates are constrained to preserve the user request, avoid unsupported entities, and remain within the generator context budget. Candidate validity is checked by a frozen Qwen/Qwen3.5-9B copy that is separate from the trainable prompt-policy weights. The checker receives the original request and one candidate and deterministically returns PASS/FAIL under a fixed rubric: a candidate fails if it changes required entities, counts, relations, actions, or event ordering, or introduces unsupported entities; descriptive camera, lighting, and appearance details are permitted only when they do not alter those constraints. Greedy decoding is used, and the same checker and rubric are applied to all prompt-side baselines and to additional support probes. Rejected candidates are resampled before video generation. For the theory above, π ϕ \pi_{\phi} denotes the effective distribution over accepted prompt actions induced by this fixed filtering rule. The exactness claim concerns the hierarchical reward decomposition and its score-function baseline identity; the practical prompt-policy update uses the clipped group-relative surrogate in Table 5 . The same accepted-action sampling rule is used for all prompt-side methods.
paragraphs.zh: 训练池包含 8,000 个 T2V 请求。 我们基于 4,800 个通过编程实例化的组合模板（涵盖实体、属性、关系、计数和行动）构建该池；此外还包括 2,000 个独立生成的运动/交互请求，以及 1,200 个人工筛选的多事件请求。随后，我们将这些请求按对象/属性绑定、空间关系、运动绑定、行动绑定、交互、数值能力以及更长的事件描述进行分层混合。 在训练前，我们会通过归一化精确匹配、5-gram MinHash（Jaccard 阈值 0.80）和句子嵌入余弦相似度（阈值 0.92），将请求与每个基准测试分集进行去重处理；没有任何保留的训练请求会跨越这些阈值中的任何一个。 验证提示在请求层面是互斥的，且绝不会用于基准测试的报告。 提示候选项受到限制，必须保留用户请求、避免使用不支持的实体，并保持在生成器的上下文预算范围内。 候选项的有效性由一个独立的冻结版 Qwen/Qwen3.5-9B 模型进行检查，该模型与可训练的提示策略权重分离。 检查器接收原始请求和一个候选项，并根据固定的评分标准确定性地返回“通过”或“失败”：如果候选项改变了所需的实体、计数、关系、行动或事件顺序，或者引入了不支持的实体，则判定为失败；描述性相机、灯光和外观细节仅在不会改变上述约束条件时允许使用。 我们采用贪心解码策略，并将相同的检查器和评分标准应用于所有提示侧基线以及额外的支持探针。 被拒绝的候选项在视频生成前会被重新采样。 在上述理论中，π ϕ \pi_{\phi} 表示由这一固定过滤规则所引发的、对已接受提示行动的有效分布。 精确性主张涉及分层奖励分解及其得分函数基线恒等性；而实际的提示策略更新则使用表 5 中的截断组相对替代目标函数。 所有提示侧方法均使用相同的已接受行动采样规则。

paragraphs.en: We additionally instantiate functional coordination on a Diffusion-DRF differentiable reward-flow backend ( Wang et al., 2026b ) . Following the public DRF setup, the critic is frozen Qwen2.5-VL-7B ; ten uniformly sampled video frames are used for VLM feedback, and gradients are truncated to the final three denoising steps. At a routed state we take the differentiable reward gradient with respect to the backend transition output as q t R q_{t}^{R} and use its native Euclidean output metric for g t R g_{t}^{R} . Alternative-prompt responses are evaluated at the identical state under the detached generator snapshot. The same trust clip, trace-normalized ridge operator, and held-out support gate are then applied before backpropagating the routed reward direction. Critic weights, frame sampling, the three-step backpropagation window, gradient checkpointing, and non-reward stabilization terms are held fixed between hierarchy-only and Full. This experiment tests whether cross-module routing remains useful when the generator already receives dense differentiable feedback rather than a scalar policy-gradient advantage.

paragraphs.en: Functional coordination requires two backend-local objects: (i) an output coordinate in which changing text conditioning at a fixed state yields a response vector, and (ii) a local improvement covector q t R q_{t}^{R} supplied by the generator updater. Flow-GRPO, RVM, and differentiable reward flow provide both directly. A preference objective can be compatible if its implementation exposes a differentiable state-local pairwise loss, in which case the loss gradient can play the role of q t R q_{t}^{R} ; a purely trajectory-level preference update with no local improvement covector is outside the current formulation. Likewise, closed API-only generators are outside our target setting because joint generator post-training itself already assumes access to internal transitions and parameters.
paragraphs.zh: 功能协调需要两个后端本地对象：(i) 一个输出坐标，在该坐标中，在固定状态下改变文本条件会产生一个响应向量；以及 (ii) 由生成器更新器提供的局部改进协向量 q t R q_{t}^{R}。 Flow-GRPO、RVM 和可微奖励流都能直接提供这两个对象。 如果偏好目标的实现暴露了一个可微的状态-局部成对损失，那么该目标就可以兼容；在这种情况下，损失梯度可以扮演 q t R q_{t}^{R} 的角色；而完全没有局部改进协向量的纯轨迹级偏好更新则超出了当前公式的范畴。 同样，仅通过封闭 API 提供的生成器也超出了我们的目标设定，因为联合生成器后训练本身已经假设能够访问内部转换和参数。

sents.zh: 功能协调需要两个后端本地对象：(i) 一个输出坐标，在该坐标中，在固定状态下改变文本条件会产生一个响应向量；以及 (ii) 由生成器更新器提供的局部改进协向量 q t R q_{t}^{R}。

sents.en: Flow-GRPO, RVM, and differentiable reward flow provide both directly.
sents.zh: Flow-GRPO、RVM 和可微奖励流都能直接提供这两个对象。

sents.en: A preference objective can be compatible if its implementation exposes a differentiable state-local pairwise loss, in which case the loss gradient can play the role of q t R q_{t}^{R} ; a purely trajectory-level preference update with no local improvement covector is outside the current formulation.
sents.zh: 如果偏好目标的实现暴露了一个可微的状态-局部成对损失，那么该目标就可以兼容；在这种情况下，损失梯度可以扮演 q t R q_{t}^{R} 的角色；而完全没有局部改进协向量的纯轨迹级偏好更新则超出了当前公式的范畴。

sents.en: Likewise, closed API-only generators are outside our target setting because joint generator post-training itself already assumes access to internal transitions and parameters.
sents.zh: 同样，仅通过封闭 API 提供的生成器也超出了我们的目标设定，因为联合生成器后训练本身已经假设能够访问内部转换和参数。

paragraphs.en: VBench ( Huang et al., 2024 ) and VBench-2.0 ( Zheng et al., 2025 ) use their official aggregate/component definitions. T2V-CompBench ( Sun et al., 2025 ) uses its official compositional dimensions and reported aggregate. StoryEval ( Wang et al., 2025 ) follows the same official event-completion protocol for every generator updater and backbone. Every checkpoint uses identical resolution, duration, scheduler steps, negative-prompt convention, and three fixed generation seeds per benchmark request. The three scores for a request are averaged first; official benchmark aggregation is then applied to those request-level means. This preserves matched stochasticity while preventing seed count from being treated as sample size.

paragraphs.en: We distinguish three sources of uncertainty: training-run variation, within-checkpoint generation randomness, and request sampling. The headline hierarchical-credit-versus-Full comparison uses three independent training runs; the functional-coordination factorial uses the same three-run protocol, and other trainable baselines use two independent runs. Confidence intervals for the headline increment are computed on paired run-level deltas using a Student- t t interval; request-level paired bootstrap intervals are retained as a within-run sensitivity analysis. Generation seeds are averaged within each checkpoint and are never treated as independent training replicates. The same checkpoint and seed definitions are used across all controlled comparisons.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将不确定性分为三个来源：训练运行差异、检查点内生成随机性以及请求采样。 主要层级信用与完整方法的比较使用了三次独立的训练运行；功能协调因子实验采用了相同的三次运行方案，而其他可训练的基线方法则使用了两次独立运行。 主要增量的置信区间基于成对的运行级差异，通过学生 t 分布区间计算得出；请求级的成对自助法置信区间则被保留为运行内的敏感性分析。 生成种子在每个检查点内部进行平均处理，且绝不会被视为独立的训练重复实验。 在所有受控比较中，均使用了相同的检查点和种子定义。

paragraphs.en: All trainable baselines draw from the same 8,000-request training pool and use the same number of request draws and decoded videos unless a comparison explicitly targets compute. The frozen official LTX-2.5 prompt enhancer uses the reference LTX-2.5 enhancement path ( Lightricks, 2026 ) : google/gemma-4-E2B-it with LTX2_5_T2V_DEFAULT_SYSTEM_PROMPT , greedy decoding ( do_sample=False ), no_repeat_ngram_size=5 , and at most 600 new tokens. Prompt-only updates Qwen3.5-9B while freezing LTX-2.5; the Flow-GRPO generator-only row keeps the original request as its text interface and is included as a single-side reference rather than as the matched joint-training control. Prompt-A-Video ( Ji et al., 2025 ) and VPO ( Cheng et al., 2025 ) use their published prompt-side objectives within the common Qwen3.5-9B prompt optimizer, training pool, LTX-2.5 generator, and evaluation harness. Because their original backbones and training stacks differ, the reported values are controlled common-harness results rather than copied published absolute scores.
paragraphs.zh: 所有可训练的基线模型都从同一个包含 8,000 个请求的训练池中抽取数据，并且使用相同数量的请求抽取和已解码视频，除非某项比较明确针对计算资源。 冻结的官方 LTX-2.5 提示增强器使用参考的 LTX-2.5 增强流程（Lightricks, 2026）：google/gemma-4-E2B-it，配合 LTX2_5_T2V_DEFAULT_SYSTEM_PROMPT、贪心解码（do_sample=False）、no_repeat_ngram_size=5，以及最多 600 个新词元。 仅提示更新 Qwen3.5-9B，同时冻结 LTX-2.5；Flow-GRPO 的仅生成器行保留原始请求作为其文本接口，并作为单边参考而非匹配的共同训练控制纳入比较。 Prompt-A-Video（Ji et al., 2025）和 VPO（Cheng et al., 2025）在共同的 Qwen3.5-9B 提示优化器、训练池、LTX-2.5 生成器和评估框架内，使用其已发布的提示侧目标。 由于它们的原始主干网络和训练堆栈不同，所报告的值是在受控共同框架下获得的结果，而非直接复制的已发布绝对分数。

paragraphs.en: PromptRL under the common video harness uses the published shared-reward joint-training principle: the trainable prompt refiner and Flow-GRPO generator receive the same terminal video reward, with candidate count, rollout count, reward stack, initialization, and update budget held fixed. UniGRPO adds group-relative normalization for the text policy and generator branch within the same joint rollout groups, retaining the published unified sparse-terminal-reward idea while keeping our LTX-2.5 backbone and reward stack fixed. We use these rows to compare joint-optimization principles within one harness, not as claims of exact reproduction of the original image-generation systems ( Wang et al., 2026a ; Liu et al., 2026 ) . Matched Global-LOO then trains the same two modules on the same K × M K\times M grid with the global leave-one-out definition in Appendix A.2 ; hierarchical credit changes only the credit hierarchy, and Full adds functional prompt shaping and generator routing.
paragraphs.zh: 在通用视频框架下，PromptRL 采用已发表的共享奖励联合训练原则：可训练的提示优化器和 Flow-GRPO 生成器接收相同的终端视频奖励，同时候选数量、展开次数、奖励堆栈、初始化和更新预算均保持固定。 UniGRPO 为同一联合展开组内的文本策略和生成器分支增加了组相对归一化，在保留已发表的统一稀疏终端奖励理念的同时，保持我们的 LTX-2.5 主干网络和奖励堆栈不变。 我们使用这些行来比较同一框架内的联合优化原则，而非声称能够完全复现原始图像生成系统（Wang et al., 2026a; Liu et al., 2026）。 Matched Global-LOO 随后基于附录 A.2 中的全局留一法定义，在相同的 K × M 网格上训练相同的两个模块；分层信用机制仅改变信用层级，而 Full 版本则增加了功能性提示塑造和生成器路由。

paragraphs.en: CAPE-T2V ( Jia et al., 2026 ) is the closest T2V-specific two-sided system in our comparison set, but it addresses the prompt–caption distribution gap through sequential Anchored-PE training followed by DiT adaptation on a separately constructed 54k video-derived caption set. Its released LTX pipeline targets LTX-2.3, whereas our mechanism-controlled study uses online joint reward post-training on LTX-2.5 with no auxiliary video-caption supervision. We therefore use CAPE-T2V for external positioning rather than treating its public absolute scores as a matched-budget ranking.
paragraphs.zh: CAPE-T2V（Jia 等人，2026）是我们比较集中最接近 T2V 专用的双向系统，但它通过顺序的 Anchored-PE 训练，随后在独立构建的 5.4 万个视频衍生字幕集上进行 DiT 适配，来解决提示与字幕之间的分布差异问题。 其发布的 LTX 流程针对的是 LTX-2.3，而我们的机制控制研究则是在 LTX-2.5 上采用在线联合奖励后训练，且没有辅助的视频-字幕监督。 因此，我们使用 CAPE-T2V 进行外部定位，而不是将其公开的绝对分数视为与预算匹配的排名依据。

paragraphs.en: Hierarchical credit makes two testable statistical predictions: prompt-conditioned generator baselines remove irrelevant prompt-to-prompt variation, while matched seeds reduce prompt-policy contrast variance when same-seed rewards are positively correlated. Both effects are measured directly rather than inferred from endpoint quality.
paragraphs.zh: 层级化信用机制提出了两个可检验的统计预测：基于提示条件的生成器基线会消除提示间无关的变异，而当同种子奖励呈正相关时，匹配的种子会降低提示与策略之间的对比方差。 这两种效应都通过直接测量获得，而非从最终结果的质量中推断得出。

paragraphs.en: Full keeps the decoded-video and reward-model-call budget identical to hierarchical credit. Under the default K = 4 K=4 and B train = 6 B_{\rm train}=6 , it additionally samples 96 accepted support prompts per request (six at the routed state of each of 16 trajectories) and performs 144 single-state generator transition forwards: 48 for the K − 1 = 3 K-1=3 rollout-candidate responses and 96 for the support probes. These operations do not decode additional videos or invoke the video reward stack. The same frozen intent checker screens support prompts; extra proposal/checker calls caused by rejection resampling are data-dependent and are therefore not included in the deterministic count. End-to-end hardware cost depends on the generator implementation and prompt-policy sampling stack, so we report deterministic operation counts rather than presenting a universal accelerator-hour ratio.

paragraphs.en: The key requirement is exact cardinality together with a coherent shared-meal scene. Base over-populates the table, so the generated composition no longer matches the requested five-person configuration. VPO moves in the opposite direction and under-populates the scene. FlowCred maintains five visible participants across the representative frames while keeping them organized around one table, preserving both the requested count and the intended conversational meal context rather than satisfying one at the expense of the other.
paragraphs.zh: 关键要求是精确的数量以及一个连贯的共享餐食场景。 Base 使场景中的人物过多，因此生成的构图不再符合所要求的五人配置。 VPO 则朝相反方向移动，导致场景中的人物过少。 FlowCred 在代表性画面中始终保持五个可见的参与者，并将他们围绕一张桌子有序安排，既保留了所要求的人数，也维持了预期的对话餐食语境，而非牺牲一方来满足另一方。

paragraphs.en: This case tests whether the model can isolate the intended pair and carry the reunion interaction through to a clear embrace. Base disperses the event into a crowded group hug, making the two target friends difficult to identify consistently. VPO produces an embrace but shows weaker protagonist focus across the sequence. paragraphs.en: The decisive constraint is the word above , so object presence alone is insufficient. Base and VPO both render a donut and a handbag but fail to maintain the requested relative placement in a stable, unambiguous form. FlowCred consistently places the donut above the handbag across the representative frames, turning an otherwise plausible pair of objects into the correct relational composition. This mirrors the larger gains on compositional evaluation, where satisfying relations rather than merely rendering entities is the harder requirement.
paragraphs.zh: 决定性的约束是上方的词语，因此仅凭物体的存在是不够的。 Base 和 VPO 都能生成一个甜甜圈和一个手提包，但无法以稳定且无歧义的形式保持所要求的相对位置。 FlowCred 在所有代表性帧中始终将甜甜圈置于手提包上方，从而将一个原本看似合理的物体组合变成了正确的关系构图。 这反映了在构图评估中更显著的改进，因为满足物体间的关系比仅仅生成实体是更难的要求。

paragraphs.en: The final case requires a coordinated temporal state change: both the chameleon and the neon sign should progress from green toward red. VPO reaches a red state but does so abruptly, with a less natural visual progression and a conspicuous change in camera behavior. paragraphs.en: We sample 240 requests stratified across compositional and multi-event categories. Three blinded annotators receive the original request and anonymized matched-seed videos with randomized left/right placement and score faithfulness, event/relation completion, motion/visual quality, and overall preference. Raw request-level proportions retain ties; the two primary significance tests condition on non-tie Full-versus-baseline outcomes and use exact binomial tests with Holm correction. Per-dimension analyses are descriptive, and Fleiss’ κ \kappa reports agreement.
paragraphs.zh: 我们从组合类和多事件类中分层抽样了 240 个请求。 三名盲注标注者收到了原始请求以及经过匿名处理的匹配种子视频，这些视频以随机化的左右位置呈现，并标注了评分的忠实度、事件/关系完整性、动作/视觉质量以及总体偏好。 原始请求层面的比例保留了平局情况；两种主要的显著性检验以非平局的“完整方案 vs. 基线方案”结果为基础，并使用精确二项检验配合 Holm 校正。 各维度的分析为描述性分析，Fleiss’ κ \kappa 报告了一致性程度。

paragraphs.en: The request-level majority analysis favors Full in both primary comparisons. Against HC, Full wins 134 requests versus 48 baseline wins, with 58 ties; conditioning on non-ties gives a 73.6% Full win rate. Against PromptRL, the corresponding counts are 142 / 52 / 46 and a 75.5% non-tie win rate. The Holm-corrected exact tests are significant in both comparisons, while Fleiss’ κ \kappa values of 0.51 and 0.53 indicate moderate agreement rather than near-deterministic annotator consensus.
paragraphs.zh: 请求级别的多数分析在两次主要比较中均支持 Full。 在与 HC 的比较中，Full 赢得 134 个请求，而基线模型仅赢得 48 个，另有 58 次平局；若仅考虑非平局情况，Full 的胜率可达 73.6%。 在与 PromptRL 的比较中，相应的数据为 142 / 52 / 46，非平局情况下的胜率为 75.5%。 Holm 校正后的精确检验在两次比较中均具有显著性，而 Fleiss 的 κ \kappa 值分别为 0.51 和 0.53，表明存在中等程度的共识，而非接近确定性的标注者一致意见。

paragraphs.en: The largest descriptive gap occurs on composition/event completion: Full is preferred on 62.9% of requests against HC and 65.8% against PromptRL. Faithfulness improves more modestly (53.3% and 55.0%), and motion/visual preference remains closer to parity (50.8% and 52.9%). This pattern is consistent with the automatic results, where the largest gains appear on compositional and multi-event benchmarks, while also showing that the preference advantage is not driven solely by a generic visual-quality shift.
paragraphs.zh: 最大的描述性差异出现在组合/事件完成度上：在请求中，62.9% 的情况更倾向于“完整”（与 HC 相比），65.8% 的情况更倾向于“完整”（与 PromptRL 相比）。 忠实度的提升较为有限（分别为 53.3% 和 55.0%），而动作/视觉偏好则更接近平衡状态（分别为 50.8% 和 52.9%）。 这一模式与自动测试结果一致：最大的改进出现在组合性和多事件基准测试中，同时表明偏好优势并非完全由泛化的视觉质量提升所驱动。

paragraphs.en: The 2 × 2 2\times 2 post-training cross-swap uses HC/Full prompt optimizers × \times HC/Full generators and freezes all modules during the audit. Substituting the Full generator into the HC pair contributes +0.90 T2V-CompBench, while substituting the Full prompt optimizer contributes +0.72; with the complementary module already Full-trained, the corresponding increments are +1.11 and +0.93. Starting from 62.63, the HC-conditioned marginal effects predict 64.25 additively, and the Full pair reaches 64.46, leaving only a descriptive +0.21 residual. The audit therefore attributes measurable gains to both trained sides without requiring a strong interaction effect between them.
paragraphs.zh: 2 × 2 2\times 2 训练后交叉交换使用了 HC/Full 提示优化器 × \times HC/Full 生成器，并在审计期间冻结了所有模块。 将 Full 生成器代入 HC 组合可带来 +0.90 T2V-CompBench 的提升，而将 Full 提示优化器代入则可带来 +0.72 的提升；由于互补模块已完成 Full 训练，对应的增量分别为 +1.11 和 +0.93。 从 62.63 开始，HC 条件化的边际效应预测值可累加得到 64.25，而 Full 组合则达到 64.46，仅余下 +0.21 的描述性残差。 因此，该审计将可测量的增益归因于两个训练过的部分，而无需它们之间存在强烈的相互作用效应。
